plan.summary: Refactor-audit AgentAI broad-catch sweep, DB-path slice (AI-1, AI-2, AI-3). Replace three broad catch(Exception) blocks wrapping DB calls with typed catch(NpgsqlException) mapped to ErrorCodes.DatabaseConnectionFailed (INV-DB-001), satisfying the repo's #1 hard-fail rule (no broad catch) while preserving each site's existing graceful/non-blocking behavior for the realistic DB-failure case. AI-1 additionally gets an OperationCanceledException { throw; } guard (it receives a real CancellationToken).
plan.q_intent: Refactor Audit Batch 6/7 broad-catch sweep, ilk servis AgentAI. Q kapsam karari: 'Sadece DB-path (AI-1,2,3) once' (en dar + en behavior-preserving; AI-reply/summarizer 4-7 ayri sonraki batch).
plan.interview_notes: Q chose the most conservative scope: DB-path broad-catches only (AI-1,2,3), deferring the AI-generation-path ones (AI-4,5,6,7) to a follow-up. Behavior approach (Q-confirmed implicitly via the conservative pick): typed-catch the realistic exception class (NpgsqlException) so graceful degradation is preserved; only truly-unexpected (non-DB) exceptions now propagate to middleware. Error-code decision: the audit's suggested ErrorCodes.DatabaseQueryFailed does NOT exist; reuse the existing canonical ErrorCodes.DatabaseConnectionFailed (INV-DB-001) to keep the batch service-local (NO Invekto.Shared/ErrorCodes change, no full-solution build, no MUST-ASK gate). OCE guard added only at AI-1 (real ct); AI-2/AI-3 pass CancellationToken.None so cancellation is impossible there (no dead-code guard).

files_changed.change: BuildProfileAsync: broad catch(Exception)->catch(OperationCanceledException){throw;} + catch(NpgsqlException) logging INV-DB-001 and returning null (graceful). Added using Npgsql + using Invekto.Shared.Constants.

/suggest DB-log catch and /feedback DB-update catch: broad catch(Exception)->catch(NpgsqlException) logging INV-DB-001 (feedback also returns INV-DB-001 instead of GeneralUnknown, still 500). Added using Npgsql.

verification_questions.question: Does mapping NpgsqlException to ErrorCodes.DatabaseConnectionFailed (INV-DB-001) at all three sites preserve the existing graceful/non-blocking behavior for the realistic DB-failure case (AI-1 returns null, AI-2 sets dbLogFailed and still returns the suggestion, AI-3 returns 500), with the only behavior change being that truly-unexpected non-DB exceptions now propagate to middleware instead of being masked?

Is the OperationCanceledException { throw; } guard correct and necessary at AI-1 (AgentProfileBuilder receives a real CancellationToken so cancellation must propagate, not degrade to null), and is its ABSENCE at AI-2/AI-3 correct because those calls pass CancellationToken.None (cancellation is impossible, so an OCE guard would be unreachable dead code)?

Is reusing the existing ErrorCodes.DatabaseConnectionFailed (INV-DB-001) the right choice here — given the audit's suggested ErrorCodes.DatabaseQueryFailed does not exist in the codebase and the batch intentionally avoids modifying Invekto.Shared/ErrorCodes — rather than introducing a new Shared error code (which would trigger a full-solution build + arch/errors.md sync)?

non_goals: Adding a new INV-DB error code
Changing status codes or response envelopes beyond the error code value
intentional_exclusions: No OCE guard at AI-2/AI-3 (CancellationToken.None makes it dead code)
Status code at AI-3 kept at 500 (behavior-preserving; not changed to 503 despite Kanban DB-error precedent)

user_facing_errors: /feedback NpgsqlException -> 500 ErrorResponse INV-DB-001 'Internal server error' (was INV-GEN-001)
/suggest DB-log failure -> 200 with warning 'Oneri kaydedilemedi, feedback takibi kullanilamayacak' (unchanged)
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: The change REDUCES silent failure: DB errors that were masked under broad catch are now logged with a distinct INV-DB-001 code. Graceful degradation (return null / non-blocking log) is intentional and preserved for the DB-failure class; non-DB unexpected exceptions, previously swallowed, now surface via middleware (loud, not silent). No new swallow introduced.

aha_moments.user_pain: On-call sees a generic error string and cannot tell a DB outage from an app bug in the agent-assist path.
aha_moments.suggestion: Tag DB-path failures with INV-DB-001 so logs disambiguate database outages from logic errors.
aha_moments.aha_moment: A DB outage now shows INV-DB-001 in logs, pointing on-call straight at PostgreSQL instead of a code bisect.

aha_moments.user_pain: A non-DB bug hidden inside a broad catch would silently degrade agent suggestions with no trace.
aha_moments.suggestion: Let truly-unexpected exceptions propagate to middleware instead of being swallowed.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Unexpected failures now produce a real stack trace, so latent bugs become visible instead of silently degrading quality.

aha_moments.user_pain: An agent gets a suggestion but feedback silently never persists, breaking learning loops.
aha_moments.suggestion: Surface the DB-coded warning when suggestion logging fails so support can correlate missing feedback to DB incidents.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Support links 'feedback not tracked' reports to INV-DB-001 windows instead of guessing.

aha_moments.user_pain: Debugging a cancelled request that mysteriously returned a degraded profile wastes time.
aha_moments.suggestion: Rethrow OperationCanceledException so cancellation is not misreported as a DB/degradation event.
aha_moments.aha_moment: A cancelled /suggest no longer logs a misleading 'feedback history failed' line.

aha_moments.user_pain: Reusing the wrong or nonexistent error code spreads inconsistency across services.
aha_moments.suggestion: Reuse the canonical existing INV-DB-001 rather than inventing a parallel DB code.
aha_moments.aha_moment: AgentAI DB errors now read identically to other services' DB errors, simplifying cross-service triage.

CQ1.evidence: iter0 FAIL (generic /feedback msg) -> iter1 fixed: specific actionable 'Failed to save feedback due to a database error. Please retry.'

CQ2.evidence: Reduces silent failure; graceful degradation preserved for DB class; non-DB now propagates.

CQ12.evidence: iter0 FAIL -> iter1 PASS: actionable INV-DB-001 message; broad catches removed.

Q1.reasoning: Graceful/non-blocking behavior preserved for realistic DB case; non-DB propagates.

Q2.reasoning: OCE throw guard at AI-1 (real ct); absent at AI-2/AI-3 (CancellationToken.None).
